skill_source: SkillsMP CI/CD category; triage-ci-flake local skill copied unchanged
design_goal: Verify that the solver follows a CI flake reproduction workflow before classifying and proposing a fix.

verification_model.main: Check the final JSON/report/diff and the recorded command trace from the mocked pnpm/curl/lsof toolchain.
verification_model.guardrails: Reject solvers that infer from logs only, run the full suite, skip prod reproduction, edit CI inputs, or disable the failing test.

control_variable: with_skill and without_skill differ only by whether environment/skills is copied into the runtime image.
reference_style: Aligned with devops/cicd skillsbench_reference tasks that ask solvers to inspect realistic CI artifacts, write analysis outputs, and produce standard diff artifacts rather than build a new app.

without_skill.dominant_failure: Skipped the pnpm/lsof reproduction workflow and failed trace validation.

notes: The mocked pnpm runner simulates a dev pass and production-bundled failure for the exact failing Playwright test.
The official solution follows the reproduction sequence and writes behavior-derived outputs.
